course.title: CI/CD — Complete Deep DevOps Course
course.description: A CI/CD-specific, beginner-to-advanced course focused on real development and production workflows, with detailed concepts, practicals, dedicated tasks, security, troubleshooting and a complete learning-platform capstone.
course.curriculumPolicy: Module and lesson counts are determined by the concepts required to learn this technology properly; no fixed cross-tool template is imposed.
learningOutcomes: Understand CI/CD from fundamentals to production usage.
Implement a production-style learning platform deployment.

modules.title: CI/CD Foundations
modules.description: Continuous integration, delivery, deployment, pipelines and feedback loops.

lessons.title: CI/CD Foundations
lessons.description: Continuous integration, delivery, deployment, pipelines and feedback loops.
learningObjectives: Apply CI/CD in a real deployment workflow.
Explain security, scaling and failure considerations.

notes.text: Continuous integration, delivery, deployment, pipelines and feedback loops.

Understand ci/cd foundations as an engineering problem first and a tool feature second. The student should know what problem it solves, what happens behind the scenes at a high level, how it fits into a real deployment, and what can go wrong.

CI/CD Foundations becomes important when a learning platform moves from local development toward repeatable, secure and scalable delivery. The goal is to understand the operational trade-offs, not merely memorize commands.

notes.caption: Add a clear architecture/flow diagram explaining CI/CD Foundations visually.
